count_flops_basic: count the total flops of a PyTorch nn.Module forward pass given example inputs
count_flops_with_estimates: count flops of a PyTorch module including approximate estimates for elementwise ops like sqrt and sigmoid
count_flops_with_overrides: count flops of a PyTorch module using custom counter functions to override default operator flop counts
review_SINGLE_FLOP_OPS_TO_ADD: review the list of aten ops like add and mul that are counted as one flop per output element
review_SINGLE_FLOP_ESTIMATES_TO_ADD: review the list of aten ops like exp and log that can optionally be estimated as one flop per element
